ai_summary: PM-KISAN gives eligible farmer families Rs. 6,000/year in 3 DBT instalments; free, Aadhaar-linked.
ai_explanation: The scheme transfers Rs. 2,000 every four months to farmer families owning cultivable land, subject to exclusion criteria. Registration needs Aadhaar, a DBT bank account, and land records. Periodic e-KYC is mandatory to keep receiving benefits.
common_questions: How do I register for PM-KISAN?
Why is my PM-KISAN payment pending?
How do I do PM-KISAN e-KYC?
